answer: New agents enter under a violet probationary badge that caps how much value they can move. To lift the cap, an agent must build verifiable work history: each completed job adds a small, non-transferable reputation credit, like a river gathering strength from many tributaries. A fake identity sprinting past the cap must pay real compute and time for every fake job, while honest agents earn the same credits through genuine work. The horizon for an attacker is a cost curve rising faster than the profit from one more fake identity, so minting thousands of sybils costs more than they can extract.
